description: Defines the ProjectActivity entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_project_activity' database table and including properties such as id, project, deletion status, name, and associated timesheet items.

classes.name: ProjectActivity
classes.description: An entity representing a project activity in OrangeHRM, with related project, timesheet items, and metadata such as activity ID, name, and deleted status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the project activity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the project activity.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates a Project entity with this activity.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the activity is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Sets the deletion status of the activity.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the project activity.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the project activity.
